Subject: Clarification regarding your recent email

Dear [Name],

Thank you for your email. I would be happy to forward the documents from our previous discussion.

To ensure I provide the most relevant input, could you please clarify which specific aspects of our future direction you would like my thoughts on? Additionally, you mentioned naming the shape with three sides; could you please provide more context on how this relates to the documents or the next steps?

I look forward to your guidance.

Best regards,

[Your Name]
